Type.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] Respondents from the interview study, who were interpreted by the authors as describing shame reactions, were chosen for the present shame study.

Area.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] Nine respondents used the words 'shame' or 'being ashamed' to describe experiences during the hospitalization after the suicide attempt. Another respondent said that he felt 'a little bit stupid' and yet another respondent relayed feelings of failure and of being exposed. One respondent described how he became paralysed once when he felt that he was being punished and treated disrespectfully by the personnel and then fled from the incident. Another respondent felt ignored by the personnel and reacted to this with cynicism and withdrawal.
